slides.title: Fighting spreads in rural northwestern Tigray
slides.body: What Wazema Radio and Addis Standard reported on Nov 26.

slides.title: Clashes since Tuesday
slides.body: Wazema says ENDF forces fought TPLF forces and Eritrean troops around Nafra, Bagoni and Geza Tegaru.

slides.title: Drone strikes reported
slides.body: Its sources say drones hit military positions and weapons depots in Waela Nihbi. No casualty figures. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Alarm raised in parliament
slides.body: During PM Abiy's appearance, an opposition MP said rights violations had reached a "deeply concerning level", citing the EHRC.

slides.title: Arsi, Wollega, Moyale named
slides.body: MPs also cited parts of Amhara, Central Ethiopia and the West Guji border, and asked how displaced people will return.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate all abuses.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Wazema Radio; Addis Standard · Nov 26, 2026
